title: Goldman Sachs Reports 2026 Third Quarter Earnings Per Common Share of $17.01 and Annualized Return on Common Equity of 18.7%
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK, October 13, 2026** – The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. (NYSE: GS) today reported net revenues of $18.68 billion and net earnings of $5.29 billion for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Diluted earnings per common share (EPS) was $17.01 and annualized return on average common shareholders’ equity (ROE) was18.7% for the third quarter of 2026.


Please view printable versions of the[Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Results](https://www.goldmansachs.com/pressroom/press-releases/current/pdfs/2026-q3-results.pdf) \[PDF\] and the[Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Results Presentation](https://www.goldmansachs.com/pressroom/press-releases/current/pdfs/2026-q3-earnings-results-presentation.pdf) \[PDF\].


**David Solomon, Chairman and CEO of Goldman Sachs, said,** “Against the backdrop of a complicated operating environment, our clients continued to turn to Goldman Sachs for our world-class advice, execution and financing capabilities, resulting in our second highest quarterly net revenues and record year-to-date net revenues. Notwithstanding the current complexity and uncertainty in the world, we remain very well positioned to continue to deliver for our clients. I am confident our market-leading franchises, deep relationships and continued investments will help drive long-term earnings growth."


A conference call to discuss the firm’s financial results, outlook and related matters will be held at 9:30 am (ET) on the date noted above. The call will be open to the public.


Members of the public who would like to listen to the conference call should dial +1-800-330-6730 (in the U.S.) and +1-646-769-9500 (outside the U.S.) passcode number 7042022. The number should be dialed at least 10 minutes prior to the start of the conference call. The conference call will also be accessible as an audio webcast through the Investor Relations section of the firm’s website,[www.goldmansachs.com/investor-relations](https://www.goldmansachs.com/investor-relations) . There is no charge to access the call. For those unable to listen to the live broadcast, a replay will be available on our website beginning approximately three hours after the event.


Please direct any questions regarding obtaining access to the conference call to Goldman Sachs Investor Relations, via e-mail, atgs-investor-relations@gs.com .
